570			return nil
571		}
572		return pricing
573	}

752	// selectProviderIndex returns the provider list index to use for a backend pool
753	// given the strategy and a rotation counter.
754	//
755	// Supported strategies:
756	//   - "first-available" (default): always index 0
757	//   - "round-robin": counter % len(providers)
758	func selectProviderIndex(strategy string, counter, numProviders int) int {
759		if numProviders <= 0 {
760			return 0

769	// ResolveBackend resolves a named backend pool to a concrete provider and model.
770	//
771	// counter is the rotation index used for round-robin selection; it should be
772	// the number of prior requests against this backend pool. Callers that want
773	// stateless first-available behavior can always pass 0.
774	//
775	// overrides.Model, when set, bypasses the catalog and uses the given concrete
776	// model string. overrides.ModelRef, when set, overrides the backend's own
777	// model_ref. If neither the backend nor the overrides specify a model, the
778	// provider's configured default model is used.
779	func (c *Config) ResolveBackend(name string, counter int, overrides ProviderOverrides) (agent.Provider, ProviderConfig, *modelcatalog.ResolvedTarget, error) {
780		bc, ok := c.Backends[name]
781		if !ok {
782			return nil, ProviderConfig{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("config: unknown backend pool %q", name)
783		}
784		if len(bc.Providers) == 0 {
785			return nil, ProviderConfig{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("config: backend pool %q has no providers", name)
786		}
787	
788		idx := selectProviderIndex(bc.Strategy, counter, len(bc.Providers))
789		providerName := bc.Providers[idx]
790	
791		// Determine the effective model ref: explicit override takes priority over
792		// the backend's own model_ref.
793		effectiveOverrides := overrides
794		if effectiveOverrides.ModelRef == "" && bc.ModelRef != "" {
795			effectiveOverrides.ModelRef = bc.ModelRef
796		}
797	
798		p, pc, resolved, err := c.BuildProviderWithOverrides(providerName, effectiveOverrides)
799		if err != nil {
800			return nil, ProviderConfig{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("config: backend pool %q: %w", name, err)
801		}
802	
803		return p, pc, resolved, nil
804	}
